description: Source code for generating protocol type definitions for Playwright, including functions to generate protocol types for Chromium, WebKit, and Firefox, utilizing external modules like 'path', 'fs', 'node-stream-zip', 'vm', and 'os'.

methods.name: generateProtocol
methods.description: Main function to generate protocol definitions based on browser name ('chromium', 'firefox', 'webkit').

methods.name: generateChromiumProtocol
methods.description: Generates Chromium protocol type definitions by launching a Chromium browser, retrieving protocol JSON, and converting it to TypeScript.

methods.name: generateWebKitProtocol
methods.description: Generates WebKit protocol type definitions by reading a JSON file and converting it to TypeScript.

methods.name: generateFirefoxProtocol
methods.description: Generates Firefox protocol type definitions by extracting and parsing a protocol JavaScript file from a ZIP archive.

methods.name: jsonToTS
methods.description: Converts protocol JSON object into TypeScript namespace definitions.

methods.name: firefoxJSONToTS
methods.description: Converts Firefox protocol JSON object into TypeScript namespace definitions.

methods.name: typeOfProperty
methods.description: Determines TypeScript type string from a property object.

methods.name: firefoxTypeToString
methods.description: Converts Firefox protocol type object into TypeScript type string.
